definitions.explanation: A recurring fee paid each month for membership in an organization, gym, club, or subscription service.

examples.japanese: {月|げっ}{会費|かいひ}は{三千|さんぜん}{円|えん}です。
examples.english: The monthly membership fee is 3,000 yen.

examples.japanese: ジムの{月|げっ}{会費|かいひ}を{払|はら}い{忘|わす}れた。
examples.english: I forgot to pay my gym's monthly fee.

examples.japanese: {月|げっ}{会費|かいひ}が{値上|ねあ}げされたので、{退会|たいかい}を{考|かんが}えている。
examples.english: The monthly fee was raised, so I'm considering canceling my membership.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly used for gym memberships, club dues, and subscription services. The fee is typically paid by automatic bank transfer ({口座|こうざ}{振替|ふりかえ}) in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月|げっ}{会費|かいひ}を{払|はら}う (to pay monthly dues)
- {月|げっ}{会費|かいひ}が{高|たか}い／{安|やす}い (monthly fee is expensive/cheap)
- {月|げっ}{会費|かいひ}の{値上|ねあ}げ (monthly fee increase)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {年会費|ねんかいひ}: annual membership fee — paid once per year
- {入会金|にゅうかいきん}: enrollment fee — one-time fee to join
